title: Stuttering issue
body:
### Tested versions

Godot Engine v4.5.1.stable.official.f62fdbde1 - https://godotengine.org
D3D12 12_0 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060

I tested on 4.4 stable too

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8180) - AMD Ryzen 7 7700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.15 GiB memory

### Issue description

I was told to post it here as no one in the godot discord knows what is happening to me
I have a horrible stuttering issue within godot
I have done everything within the stuttering article to no prevail
The issue is not due to my code or theres to much going on in my game as its one node with a script that moves it I also tested in pre made projects where the bug continues
Currently I've tried:
- Fixing the code
- Going from vulkan to D3D12
- The things in the article that it suggested
- Updating my drivers
- Locking my monitors fps to 60

Weird quirks:
- For some reason when recording the issue isn't nearly as bad as it is when its displayed on my screen though it is still noticeable within recording for some reason on my screen it looks like the logo is melding together as it moves (Basically on my screen it looks 10x worse than it does while recording)
- Turning my monitor to 165hz makes it way less horrible but its still there just way smaller stutters
- Performance tracker doesn't show anything not even sure what I'd be looking for there anyways
- Compatibility mode does fix it but I'd prefer to not be trapped in compatibility mode

(most noticeable in this video)
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8597710c-157d-494b-b89f-ac30e9b3dd73

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fc54ab02-8b6a-4ddc-863a-3513d972cc5c

### Steps to reproduce

Pressing the play button and moving

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I'll be real its every godot project I do this is just the ones I was using when I first noticed it

[minimum build.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23662331/minimum.build.zip)
